mapper.sql: SELECT 'PAYMENT_ATTEMPT' AS flow_source, pa.attempt_no AS flow_no, pa.payment_order_id, po.order_no, pa.prepay_order_no, prepay.pay_scene, '支付尝试' AS flow_type, 'info' AS flow_type_tag, pa.channel_code, pa.terminal, pa.client_ip, pa.idempotency_key, pa.attempt_status AS business_status, pa.attempt_status_type AS business_status_type, NULL AS notify_type, NULL AS route_rule, NULL AS downstream_system, NULL AS event_topic, NULL AS publish_status, NULL AS retry_count, pa.request_payload, pa.response_payload, CONCAT('方式=', pa.payment_method, ' / 状态=', pa.attempt_status) AS summary, DATE_FORMAT(pa.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at, 1 AS flow_source_rank, pa.id AS flow_source_id FROM t_payment_attempt pa LEFT JOIN t_payment_order po ON po.payment_order_id = pa.payment_order_id LEFT JOIN t_prepay_order prepay ON prepay.prepay_order_no = pa.prepay_order_no AND CHAR_LENGTH(prepay.prepay_order_no) = CHAR_LENGTH(pa.prepay_order_no) AND CAST(prepay.prepay_order_no AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(pa.prepay_order_no AS BINARY(256)) AND prepay.payment_order_id = pa.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(prepay.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(pa.payment_order_id) AND CAST(prepay.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(pa.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) UNION ALL SELECT 'CHANNEL_NOTIFY' AS flow_source, pnl.notify_no AS flow_no, pnl.payment_order_id, po.order_no, NULL AS prepay_order_no, (SELECT latest_pr.pay_scene FROM t_prepay_order latest_pr WHERE latest_pr.payment_order_id = pnl.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(latest_pr.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(pnl.payment_order_id) AND CAST(latest_pr.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(pnl.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) ORDER BY latest_pr.created_at DESC, latest_pr.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS pay_scene, '渠道回调' AS flow_type, 'warn' AS flow_type_tag, pnl.channel_code, NULL AS terminal, NULL AS client_ip, NULL AS idempotency_key, pnl.notify_status AS business_status, pnl.notify_status_type AS business_status_type, pnl.notify_type, NULL AS route_rule, NULL AS downstream_system, NULL AS event_topic, NULL AS publish_status, NULL AS retry_count, pnl.notify_payload AS request_payload, pnl.notify_result AS response_payload, CONCAT('类型=', pnl.notify_type, ' / 状态=', pnl.notify_status) AS summary, DATE_FORMAT(pnl.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at, 2 AS flow_source_rank, pnl.id AS flow_source_id FROM t_payment_notify_log pnl LEFT JOIN t_payment_order po ON po.payment_order_id = pnl.payment_order_id UNION ALL SELECT 'ROUTE_RECORD' AS flow_source, prr.route_no AS flow_no, prr.payment_order_id, po.order_no, pa.prepay_order_no, prepay.pay_scene, '路由记录' AS flow_type, 'info' AS flow_type_tag, prr.channel_code, pa.terminal, pa.client_ip, pa.idempotency_key, prr.route_result AS business_status, 'info' AS business_status_type, NULL AS notify_type, prr.route_rule, NULL AS downstream_system, NULL AS event_topic, NULL AS publish_status, NULL AS retry_count, NULL AS request_payload, NULL AS response_payload, CONCAT('规则=', prr.route_rule, ' / 结果=', prr.route_result) AS summary, DATE_FORMAT(prr.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at, 3 AS flow_source_rank, prr.id AS flow_source_id FROM t_payment_route_record prr LEFT JOIN t_payment_order po ON po.payment_order_id = prr.payment_order_id LEFT JOIN t_payment_attempt pa ON pa.attempt_no = prr.attempt_no AND CHAR_LENGTH(pa.attempt_no) = CHAR_LENGTH(prr.attempt_no) AND CAST(pa.attempt_no AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(prr.attempt_no AS BINARY(256)) AND pa.payment_order_id = prr.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(pa.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(prr.payment_order_id) AND CAST(pa.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(prr.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) LEFT JOIN t_prepay_order prepay ON prepay.prepay_order_no = pa.prepay_order_no AND CHAR_LENGTH(prepay.prepay_order_no) = CHAR_LENGTH(pa.prepay_order_no) AND CAST(prepay.prepay_order_no AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(pa.prepay_order_no AS BINARY(256)) AND prepay.payment_order_id = pa.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(prepay.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(pa.payment_order_id) AND CAST(prepay.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(pa.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) UNION ALL SELECT 'BUSINESS_EVENT' AS flow_source, pe.event_no AS flow_no, pe.payment_order_id, pe.biz_no AS order_no, NULL AS prepay_order_no, (SELECT latest_pr.pay_scene FROM t_prepay_order latest_pr WHERE latest_pr.payment_order_id = pe.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(latest_pr.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(pe.payment_order_id) AND CAST(latest_pr.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(pe.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) ORDER BY latest_pr.created_at DESC, latest_pr.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS pay_scene, '业务事件' AS flow_type, 'success' AS flow_type_tag, po.channel_code, NULL AS terminal, NULL AS client_ip, NULL AS idempotency_key, pe.event_type AS business_status, CASE WHEN pe.event_type = 'PAYMENT_SUCCESS' THEN 'success' WHEN pe.event_type = 'PAYMENT_CLOSED' THEN 'danger' ELSE 'info' END AS business_status_type, NULL AS notify_type, NULL AS route_rule, pe.downstream_system, pe.event_topic, pe.publish_status, pe.retry_count, pe.event_payload AS request_payload, NULL AS response_payload, CONCAT('事件=', pe.event_type, ' / 发布=', pe.publish_status) AS summary, DATE_FORMAT(pe.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at, 4 AS flow_source_rank, pe.id AS flow_source_id FROM t_payment_event pe LEFT JOIN t_payment_order po ON po.payment_order_id = pe.payment_order_id

FROM t_payment_attempt pa LEFT JOIN t_payment_order po ON po.payment_order_id = pa.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(po.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(pa.payment_order_id) AND CAST(po.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(pa.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) LEFT JOIN t_prepay_order pr ON pr.prepay_order_no = pa.prepay_order_no AND CHAR_LENGTH(pr.prepay_order_no) = CHAR_LENGTH(pa.prepay_order_no) AND CAST(pr.prepay_order_no AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(pa.prepay_order_no AS BINARY(256)) AND pr.payment_order_id = pa.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(pr.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(pa.payment_order_id) AND CAST(pr.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(pa.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) LEFT JOIN t_order standard_order ON standard_order.order_no = po.order_no AND CHAR_LENGTH(standard_order.order_no) = CHAR_LENGTH(po.order_no) AND CAST(standard_order.order_no AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(po.order_no AS BINARY(256)) AND pr.order_no = po.order_no AND CHAR_LENGTH(pr.order_no) = CHAR_LENGTH(po.order_no) AND CAST(pr.order_no AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(po.order_no AS BINARY(256)) AND pr.source_kind = 'STANDARD_ORDER' AND CHAR_LENGTH(pr.source_kind) = CHAR_LENGTH('STANDARD_ORDER') AND CAST(pr.source_kind AS BINARY(16)) = CAST('STANDARD_ORDER' AS BINARY(16)) LEFT JOIN t_payment_route_record attempt_route ON attempt_route.id = ( SELECT prr.id FROM t_payment_route_record prr WHERE prr.attempt_no = pa.attempt_no AND CHAR_LENGTH(prr.attempt_no) = CHAR_LENGTH(pa.attempt_no) AND CAST(prr.attempt_no AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(pa.attempt_no AS BINARY(256)) AND prr.payment_order_id = pa.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(prr.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(pa.payment_order_id) AND CAST(prr.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(pa.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) ORDER BY prr.created_at DESC, prr.id DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE pa.attempt_no = #{flowNo} AND CHAR_LENGTH(pa.attempt_no) = CHAR_LENGTH(#{flowNo}) AND CAST(pa.attempt_no AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(#{flowNo} AS BINARY(256)) LIMIT 1
